event: Miami United FC defeated SCU Heat 1-1 (6-5 on penalties) in the UPSL South Region Final to advance to the National Semifinals.
SCU Heat eliminated by Miami United FC in a penalty shootout (1-1, 6-5 pens), ending an undefeated 14W-0L-3T Spring campaign with a +43 goal differential.
NY Renegades FC defeated Detroit City FC II 3-1 in the East Region Final to advance to the UPSL National Semifinals as defending champions.
Detroit City FC II eliminated by NY Renegades FC 3-1 in the UPSL East Region Final quarterfinal.
Central Kansas United claimed the UPSL Central Region Championship and advanced to the National Semifinals.
Deportivo Rose City played Next Level Soccer in the UPSL West Region Final at Cardinale Stadium; result unconfirmed at publication time.
Next Level Soccer played Deportivo Rose City in the UPSL West Region Final at Cardinale Stadium; result unconfirmed at publication time.
SCU Heat's Spring 2026 campaign ended with a 14W-0L-3T record and +43 GD, the strongest regular-season trajectory of any UPSL club this spring by confirmed metrics.
Miami United FC returns to the UPSL National Finals for the second consecutive season, with a berth in the 2027 Lamar Hunt US Open Cup on the line.
NY Renegades FC advances to UPSL National Finals at UCLA for second consecutive season, defending their national title with a US Open Cup berth at stake.
Tampa Bay Rowdies drew the USL Cup Quarterfinal home fixture vs. Louisville City FC after winning all four group stage games and conceding just one goal.
Louisville City FC drew the USL Cup Quarterfinal away fixture at Tampa Bay Rowdies after finishing group stage with 11 points and a league-leading 12 goals scored.
Hartford Athletic, defending USL Cup champions, drew an away Quarterfinal at USL League One's Charlotte Independence after winning Group 5.
Charlotte Independence (T3) earned a home USL Cup Quarterfinal against defending champion Hartford Athletic after winning Group 6 of the Prinx Tires USL Cup.
San Antonio FC drew Group 3 winner's home Quarterfinal matchup against Miami FC (wild card) in the Prinx Tires USL Cup.
Athletic Club Boise leads USL League One in total and average attendance, with a season-high of 7,227 and cumulative total of 43,248 through the data window.
Corpus Christi FC winless across all 10 matches played in 2026 USL League One season as of May 30, the longest active winless run in the league.
Fort Wayne FC held the longest unbeaten run in USL League One at 7 games through the last confirmed data window (April 11 onward).
DCFC Holdings announced largest single investment in club history tied to AlumniFi Field development; investor joins DCFC Holdings Board of Directors.
